description: Dokploy host: adapter-node behind the platform proxy, in a multi-stage container. Owns the entrypoint for both profiles that deploy here — it branches on whether litestream.yml is present, which is the one thing that actually distinguishes them, rather than making two variants fight over one file.

env.name: PORT
env.note: Set in the image to 3000. Override only if the platform needs a different port.

env.name: BODY_SIZE_LIMIT
env.note: adapter-node's request body cap. Defaults to 512K, which is plenty — uploads go straight to storage through a signed URL and never through this process.
